title: Morphbench - Mesh Morph and Collider Workbench
author: Vhodnoylogin
summary: Windows x64 NIF/TRI workbench: morphs, bounds and editable skeleton capsules, NIF/PPB exports, CLI/HTTP and browser add-ons. Application 0.8.5 + Launcher v1 use Morphbench/launcher, app and plugins. Install manually or through MO2 with optional Root Builder.

optionalNexusMods.name: Kezyma's Root Builder
optionalNexusMods.purpose: Only for MO2-managed deployment of root/Morphbench to the game root. Manual/external installation does not require it.

installation.manual: Merge Morphbench folders from inside root; run Morphbench/launcher/morphbench.exe.
installation.mo2: Separate enabled Launcher/Application mods, Application higher priority, optional Root Builder deployment; register the game-root executable.
installation.migration: Retain flat 0.8.0 installation; migrate settings and complete add-on registry into a new structured folder.
installation.updates: Close server/launcher; update App-owned files with exact Runtime check, preserving settings/plugins/native Runtime.

media.screenshots: Existing authentic 0.8.0 Morphs/Colliders captures remain representative; no game/model assets are bundled.

addonDistribution: CLAW add-on is a separate Nexus mod and is not bundled in either package.
historicalPublicationEvidence: Top-level 0.8.5 metadata is retained as historical provenance; currentPublication is the verified 0.8.6 / Launcher v2 delivery.
optionalRequirementDisclosure: Root Builder is optional for MO2 root deployment; manual/external installation needs no Root Builder. Launcher v1 is required.

pluginAuthoring.distribution: Separate ZIP or Nexus mod; install and enable through the add-on manager.

entries: Application updates can reuse compatible Launcher versions without rebuilding the workbench.
Application and settings discovery now live in the updateable Application package.
Launcher v1 remains supported. When upgrading from Application 0.8.5, use the updater extracted from the new package before replacing Launcher.
User downloads exclude developer build material. Required licences and source links remain included.
Application updates preserve settings and installed add-ons.
Improved startup error reporting and handling of failed background commands.
Added time limits and cancellation for background operations.
Fixed output-pipe handling that could leave operations waiting after a child process exited.
Made window closure and background-server cleanup more reliable. Closing Launcher leaves an independently started server running.
Kept application discovery and future interface adaptation in the Application package so ordinary workbench updates can reuse Launcher.

nexusRequirements.note: Optional. Only for installing root/Morphbench packages through MO2 and deploying them to the game root. Manual installation and existing flat tool folders do not require Root Builder.

offSiteRequirements.notes: Install both Main files. Application 0.8.6 supports Launcher v1/v2 (Runtime API 1, CPython 3.12 Windows x64). Compatibility and upgrade instructions.

entries: Moved the launcher window, settings, discovery and server control into the updateable Application.
Improved session recovery and preserved fitted capsule geometry in saved recipes and skeleton exports.
Kept repeated edits within the recovery action limit.
Improved validation of capsule radii, add-on metadata and update destinations.
Refactored editing sessions and settings ownership. Settings and installed add-ons are preserved.
Restored Morphbench window and taskbar icons. Incomplete launcher arguments now produce a diagnostic instead of silently exiting.
Reduced the native launcher to starting bundled Python and forwarding arguments and the exit code.
Moved the window and startup behavior into Application so routine fixes can reuse the same EXE.
Install Application 0.8.7 or a newer compatible Application before replacing Launcher.

offSiteRequirements.name: Morphbench Launcher / Application compatibility
offSiteRequirements.notes: Install both Main files. Launcher v3 needs Application 0.8.7 or a compatible newer App. Update Application before replacing Launcher. Application 0.8.7 supports Launcher v1, v2 and v3. Root Builder is optional.

publicationNotes: Keep historical tags, uploads and owner-authored posts unchanged.
